This situation is **a great example of how small interactions shape perceptions**. You were **trying to be helpful**, but **delivery matters as much as intent**. In customer service, **even good intentions can backfire** if not executed with care.

---
**Final Answer:** **~0.3/1** (Neutral-leaning toward "not ideal," but understandable in context.)
